# Tripo AI

> > Tripo AI is an AI-powered 3D model generation platform that converts text and images into production-ready 3D assets in seconds, supporting Unity, Unreal, Blender, and industry-standard formats (FBX, OBJ, GLB, STL).

Tripo AI provides advanced features including GPT-4o integration, auto-rigging, AI stylization, and API access for developers. The platform serves game developers, architects, urban planners, and construction professionals with tools for rapid 3D content creation, BIM/GIS workflows, and VR/MR applications.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-3D generation
- Image-to-3D conversion
- AI 3D modeling
- PBR materials
- Unity and Unreal Engine integration
- BIM (Building Information Modeling)
- GIS (Geographic Information Systems)
- 3D city modeling and urban planning
- Construction VR and architectural visualization
- Auto-rigging and character animation
- Tripo API and Tripo Studio
- FBX, OBJ, GLB, STL formats
- Blender and Godot workflows
- AI stylization (Lego, Voxel, Voronoi)
- Digital twins and virtual construction

## Core AI 3D Generation Features

- [Discover AI 3D Model Generators](https://www.tripo3d.ai/discover): Discover Tripo's AI 3D generators: text/image to high-quality 3D models
- [Text-to-3D Model Generation](https://www.tripo3d.ai/ja/features/text-to-3d-model): Text-to-3D generation feature: prompts to production-ready AI 3D models
- [GPT-4o Enhanced 3D Generation](https://www.tripo3d.ai/ru/features/image-gen-gpt-4o): Integrates GPT-4o multimodal AI with Tripo's 3D generation pipeline
- [AI Auto-Rigging](https://www.tripo3d.ai/pt/features/ai-auto-rigging): AI auto-rigging: automatic skeleton detection & skinning for 3D characters
- [AI Model Stylization](https://www.tripo3d.ai/pt/features/ai-model-stylization): AI stylization: transform models into Lego, Voxel, Voronoi styles instantly
